sources.title: In Practice: Sketching Mouths with Jake Spicer
sources.creator: Jake Spicer / V&A Academy
sources.rights: V&A/artist image and teaching materials copyright; technique observations only, no artwork/copied pixels in repository
observations: Cupid's bow is a soft volume above a narrow shadowed stomion line, not a hard oval outline
Lower lip has curved vertical texture, central reflected light and soft fade into chin
Texture uneven with crisscrossing lighter and darker pencil contacts

sources.title: How to draw lips step by step
observations: Vermilion is three-dimensional: upper lip is relatively shadowed and lower lip has a selective central highlight
Small vertical grooves and pressure variation create tissue instead of a blank skin-colored lozenge

sources.title: How to Draw Realistic Lips with COLOR NAMES – Step by Step Colored Pencil Tutorial
sources.creator: Arielle Komie
sources.rights: artist teaching video; process observed, not copied
observations: Explicit separate steps for underpaint, shadow, upper lip, lower lip, Cupid's bow and final highlights
Protect paper tooth and reserve local specular contact rather than whole-mouth bright fill

original_artwork: The existing ANAT1 468-landmark projected model defines actual mouth-line, lip upper/lower boundary, commissures and face cheek and chin. No photography sourced for identity.

baseline.type: Chromium 960×540 original CP-F1 portrait from merged PR #438
baseline.defect: Upper and lower lips appear like broad pale outlined lozenges, missing vermilion capillary ridges, soft tissue transitions, mouth corner and chin plane

part_manifest.color: soft shadowed warm rose upper labium
part_manifest.extra: 29 × 3 vertical curved tissue pencil contacts, mouth seam, cupid bow and left commissure

part_manifest.color: lighter warm pink lower lip, narrow highlight reserve
part_manifest.extra: 29 × 3 vertical tissue contacts, reflected light reserve and central contact

part_manifest.source: ANAT1 oval and 3D skin pigment triangles
part_manifest.extra: one low-pressure mentolabial turning shadow at lip-bounds +5..8 below lower border

five_axes.topology: Both lip masses retain ANAT1 exact upper/lower paths and underlying 468-landmark face; no cutout paper and no detached polygon props
five_axes.flow: Micro grooves follow near-vertical/curved lip tissue ridges, not horizontal uniform face hatching
five_axes.weight: Upper lip shadowed rose/brown, lower lip moderate rose + selective cream, darkest narrow stomion line, corners fade softly
five_axes.rhythm: 29 jittered grooves per pigment pass per lip, 3 passes ×2 lip regions, unequal length due arch curvature and seed
five_axes.texture: Native CP-F1 opaque vs translucent layer contract remains, no bitmap, blur or synthetic photon filter, original paper tooth

negative_controls: uniform flat skin-colored rectangle or pink capsule
black outline around both lip masses
detached drawn teeth or a broad white smile
